context: Request: which fund and asset-management matters include a GP clawback, and pull the executed LPAs. Rubric: 1001-00002, 1003-00002, 1024-00002, 1027-00002, 1026-00001 (an LP-side review with a memo as the only proof), proof documents for each, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Three whole-store globs (all files, documents, one file type that does not exist).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide text-extraction script for request terms; times out with partial output.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Three file-name globs for request words plus a content grep on documents; the globs list agreement files across several matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the opening of eight agreements, amendments and memos from seven candidates in the hits.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Script extracts provision text from named candidate agreements.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Six globs of candidate matter folders; the pattern matches nothing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Script extracts provision text from every document whose file name has agreement or partnership words.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Re-reads one candidate's executed amendment.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the matters with the provision and their executed or draft documents.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
tags: run ended: text reply without finish
stages.note: Edits a paragraph and re-reads the top of the response; the run ends with a closing message and no finish call.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → List files in candidate matters → Scan document text with an extraction script → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response
runs.failure_point: Found all qualifying matters, but misdescribed one it had read and asserted matters with only draft provisions.

first_error.why: Read one qualifying matter's review memo but described the matter as the reviewed sponsor's engagement rather than the client's investor-side review (evidence seen at [13]-[21]).

other_errors.why: Listed three matters with only draft or markup provisions as containing the provision.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads memos and agreements of six candidates, then later sections or openings of agreements from three matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Script extracts provision text from the transaction documents of two candidates.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords

stages.stage: Write the response

stages.stage: Finish the run

runs.failure_point: Answered from scan snippets: asserted two matters with only draft provisions and misdescribed one qualifying matter it never opened.

first_error.why: Asserted two matters with only draft or markup provisions as containing the provision, from extracted snippets.

other_errors.why: Described one qualifying matter from scan snippets and a file name, naming the wrong client and provision, without opening it.

divergence: All three surfaced and read or extracted every qualifying matter; the failures are judgement errors. T0 and T1 misdescribed one matter they had read at the screening stage (misstated facts, placed at the write stage); T2 asserted matters with only draft provisions and misdescribed another matter from snippets, both at the write stage. T0 also asserted draft-only matters and ended without a finish call.
